_comment: Shared by scripts/setup.sh (bash), packages/desktop/src/setup.cjs (node) and scripts/bundle-tools.py. Both uv digests were transcribed into two languages before this file existed, so a bump was two edits and a stale one failed as a checksum mismatch on whichever path was used less.

bundledTools._comment: Homebrew has no versioned formula for these, so they cannot be pinned by install — bundle-tools.py asserts instead, and the build stops rather than silently shipping a version nobody tested. Adopt a new one deliberately: brew upgrade ffmpeg poppler, re-run extraction and synthesis on a real book, then bundle-tools.py --update-pins.
